for (const { level = 1 } of [{ level: 2 }]) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}
for (const { mode = 'left' } of [{ mode: 'right' }]) {
  const direction: 'left' | 'right' = mode;
  console.log(direction);
}
for (const [first] of [[1, 'one']]) {
  const one: number = first;
  console.log(one);
}
for (const { callback = (n: number) => n } of [{ callback: n => n }]) console.log(callback(1));

const stored = [{}] as const;
for (const { level = 1 } of stored) console.log(level);

for (const { level = 1 } of true ? [{ level: 2 }] : [{}]) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}
for (const { mode = 'left' } of true ? [{ mode: 'right' }] : [{}]) {
  const direction: 'left' | 'right' = mode;
  console.log(direction);
}
for (const { level = 1 } of true ? [{ level: 2 }] : [{}] as const) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}
for (const [{ level = 1 }] of true ? [[{ level: 2 }]] : [[{}]]) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}

const empty: {}[] = [{}];
for (const { level = 1 } of true ? [{ level: 2 }] : empty) console.log(level);
for (const { level = 1 } of true ? [2] : [{}]) console.log(level);
